title: runIT firmware limits
description: Output of templates/generate_limits.py: every Kconfig option marked `#@limit`, with the value the firmware is built with. These are the numbers a program or a frame can run into (pins per block, the program arena, the largest frame); an app checks against them before it uploads. Generated; do not edit.

limits.description: Published limits by Kconfig name without the CONFIG_ prefix (VM_BLOCK_MAX_IN).

config.description: The option as sdkconfig and the C code name it.

value.description: The value the firmware is built with (sdkconfig). A board built with another configuration publishes its own.

alias.description: The title a user sees (@alias of the marker).

description.description: The first paragraph of the option's help.

unit.description: What the value counts (bytes, pins, levels, objects).

source_file.description: The Kconfig file, relative to the repository root.
